coverage_template: the Astemia Medical Solutions for Integrated Care Records Service services A to Z, directory A (https://www.kch.nhs.uk/services/services-a-to-z/, snapshot 18 November 2026)

groups.name: Emergency and ambulance
groups.workflow: ED nurse records arrival and triage, then the ED clinician records disposition or admission.
groups.security_checks: Require active ED context and paediatric proxy checks. Limit temporary identity access to authorised teams.
groups.acceptance: Replay the same ambulance handover with a temporary patient ID. One arrival remains and the confirmed identity retains all triage events.

groups.name: Acute and ambulatory medicine
groups.workflow: Acute team converts a referral to an assessment or observation episode and allocates investigation and result ownership.
groups.security_checks: Limit worklists to the service and facility. Require assigned ownership before completing a handover.
groups.acceptance: Close an ambulatory visit with an outstanding investigation. The worklist still shows the named reviewer.

groups.name: Critical care and anaesthesia
groups.workflow: Critical-care staff accept transfer and capture observations, authorised intervention records and ward handback.
groups.security_checks: Restrict entry and sign-off to assigned credentialed staff. Keep each handover version and its recipient.
groups.acceptance: Transfer a patient out of ICU. The old bed releases once and the ward receives one signed handover.

groups.name: Older people and frailty
groups.workflow: Geriatric team records an assessment, agrees goals and assigns community follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Check representative authority for applicable actions and scope social-care disclosure.
groups.acceptance: Revoke an expired representative grant while retaining the active care-team task.

groups.name: Heart and vascular medicine
groups.workflow: Cardiology accepts referral, requests investigations and assigns an outcome to inpatient, outpatient, community or rehabilitation follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Restrict device/result access to the treating team. Check community partner scope at transmission.
groups.acceptance: Missed acknowledgement of a released investigation routes to the configured cardiology fallback only once.

groups.name: Respiratory and sleep medicine
groups.workflow: Respiratory team requests tests, reviews results and allocates monitoring or rehabilitation.
groups.security_checks: Apply approved result-release controls and scoped access for longitudinal records.
groups.acceptance: A corrected lung-function report retains its original and reopens the clinician review.

groups.name: Diabetes and endocrinology
groups.workflow: Assign a named plan owner and link care activity to the current endocrine or diabetes plan, cross-referencing renal, maternity or transplant episodes where applicable.
groups.security_checks: Require approved shared-team access. Restrict behavioural-health material in ordinary chart summaries.
groups.acceptance: An amended plan changes future activity and preserves the prior version for completed reviews.

services.name: Diabetes disordered eating and psychological support

groups.name: Renal care and dialysis
groups.workflow: Renal coordinator schedules recurring treatment against a versioned plan and records completed sessions and access referrals.
groups.security_checks: Check dialysis role and site assignment and scope access to the linked procedure and device information.
groups.acceptance: Retry recurring-session creation after partial failure. One session remains for each configured instance.

services.name: Vascular access and line insertion team

groups.name: Digestive medicine and endoscopy
groups.workflow: Screening or clinical referral creates an endoscopy pathway with triage, booking, procedure, specimen and result ownership.
groups.security_checks: Check endoscopy credential and patient consent evidence. Scope screening export to the approved recipient.
groups.acceptance: One biopsy taken during endoscopy links to the procedure and its later result, with one named reviewer.

groups.name: Liver and transplant medicine
groups.workflow: Hepatology manages investigation and MDT review, then links an accepted transplant referral to longitudinal follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Scope donor and recipient records independently when donor information is present. Restrict transplant status changes to the approved role.
groups.acceptance: An ordinary ward user sees the allowed recipient summary while donor details remain restricted.

groups.name: Immunology dermatology and rheumatology
groups.workflow: Specialty team vets referral and records examination, tests, clinical images and multidisciplinary transfer if needed.
groups.security_checks: Segregate sensitive images, scope image access by patient and preserve image consent and changes.
groups.acceptance: A dermatology image remains inaccessible through a link copied from a different patient record.

groups.name: Infection and ambulatory antimicrobials
groups.workflow: Create an approved outpatient or home administration plan, assign a qualified team and record the visit and observed supply or administration outcome.
groups.security_checks: Apply sensitivity limitations and scope community team access to assigned patients. Apply recipient policy before lab release.
groups.acceptance: An unsuccessful home visit creates a single reconciliation task. HIV notes remain hidden from a staff member without the applicable permission.

groups.name: General colorectal and hepatopancreatobiliary surgery
groups.workflow: Surgical team vets the referral, confirms capacity and creates the operative and recovery records.
groups.security_checks: Require credentialed signatures and verified case, procedure and recipient before theatre or ward handover.
groups.acceptance: Cancel an ambulatory operation. Theatre capacity releases and its owner receives one follow-up task.

groups.name: Cardiothoracic vascular and endocrine surgery
groups.workflow: Book an assessed patient to a theatre slot and capture the signed procedural and recovery record.
groups.security_checks: Require approved procedural privileges and keep any override under a separate audited action.
groups.acceptance: Attempt to book an unavailable asset or sign a case as an unauthorised role. The worklist stays consistent.

groups.name: Trauma orthopaedics and spine
groups.workflow: Trauma staff assign fracture follow-up and capture laterality, treatment decision and operative or virtual outcome.
groups.security_checks: Restrict procedure sign-off and transfers by role. Use approved clinical safety validation for laterality.
groups.acceptance: A conflicting laterality prevents moving the case forward under the configured safety policy and records the discrepancy.

groups.name: Urology and eye care
groups.workflow: Allocate separate urology and ophthalmology service nodes and worklists. Record consultation, procedure, laterality where relevant and follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Check specialty role and procedural scope and restrict protected images to assigned patients.
groups.acceptance: A urology user cannot retrieve the ophthalmology worklist without an applicable grant.

groups.name: Oral dental and craniofacial care
groups.workflow: Dental team records tooth/site, care plan, specialty assessment and completed dental or reconstructive procedure.
groups.security_checks: Apply specialty and minor confidentiality rules. Scope community dental sharing and sensitive dental psychology notes.
groups.acceptance: Two procedures on different tooth sites remain separate and a hospital-only note stays out of a community referral.

groups.name: Solid tumour oncology
groups.workflow: Create tumour-site pathways with screening, biopsy, staging evidence, multidisciplinary decisions and procedure or urgent routing.
groups.security_checks: Limit raw pathology, genomic material if collected and MDT documents to the approved scope. Audit exceptional release.
groups.acceptance: Amended pathology routes to the cancer MDT reviewer without silently overwriting the original staging evidence.

groups.name: Systemic cancer treatment
groups.workflow: Version the approved treatment plan, then schedule and record cycles, administration, omissions and review.
groups.security_checks: Apply site-approved verification, qualification and distinct approval controls for medication steps.
groups.acceptance: A superseded plan cannot be used for a new cycle. An already administered cycle preserves its plan version.

groups.name: Haematology and stem-cell services
groups.workflow: Maintain separate diagnostic, transfusion and transplant workflows with linked results, cases and authorisations.
groups.security_checks: Scope donor, cell product and recipient data by role and use. Require protected review of identity discrepancies.
groups.acceptance: A therapy-product mismatch requires reconciliation and creates an auditable exception rather than an administration record.

groups.name: Palliative end of life and bereavement
groups.workflow: Record preferences, handover and follow-up, including referral to a bereavement service when appropriate.
groups.security_checks: Verify approved recipients and purpose before family or partner disclosures. Segment sensitive preferences as applicable.
groups.acceptance: Closing the clinical episode preserves the bereavement referral and authorisation evidence.

groups.name: Neurology and neurophysiology
groups.workflow: Neurology schedules studies and reviews results against the current diagnostic or longitudinal pathway.
groups.security_checks: Scope device-linked recordings and cognitive assessments to approved users. Limit portal release under site rules.
groups.acceptance: An amended video EEG report opens one review and remains hidden from the portal until released.

groups.name: Stroke neurosurgery and neurovascular care
groups.workflow: Create an acute or elective pathway from referral/activation through imaging, procedure, handover and rehabilitation.
groups.security_checks: Use assigned team grants and independently authorised image access. Restrict implant/device information updates to the owning team.
groups.acceptance: An external stroke transfer includes the approved summary without exposing an unrestricted whole-chart export.

groups.name: Rehabilitation and allied health
groups.workflow: Create discipline-specific assessments and goals with named owner, outcome and review date.
groups.security_checks: Share agreed multidisciplinary fields while applying privacy to restricted discipline notes.
groups.acceptance: A multidisciplinary review shows authorised outcome fields and does not disclose protected neuropsychology notes.

groups.name: Maternity obstetrics and fetal medicine
groups.workflow: Create the maternal pregnancy episode, arrange fetal assessment, record delivery and open newborn records where applicable.
groups.security_checks: Require maternal and neonatal permissions independently. Restrict pregnancy and related disclosure to approved context.
groups.acceptance: A fetal scan links to the maternal episode and two newborn records retain distinct identifiers after a twin birth.

groups.name: Gynaecology fertility and reproductive care
groups.workflow: Record referral reason, specialist assessment and agreed procedure or follow-up in the appropriate service node.
groups.security_checks: Apply separate permissions to sensitive fertility or reproductive services and proxy restrictions before portal publication.
groups.acceptance: A proxy with general access cannot retrieve a restricted report when the site policy excludes it.

groups.name: Paediatrics and paediatric surgery
groups.workflow: Assign age-appropriate specialist worklists, neonatal beds, operative cases and paediatric follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Check age policy and verified current authority. Mask pregnancy or parent information unless independently justified.
groups.acceptance: Revoking guardianship blocks access to the child\'s documents while preserving the clinical team\'s access.

groups.name: Paediatric specialty medicine
groups.workflow: Create specialty referral and multidisciplinary plan. Link results and treatment to the child with documented authority and care context.
groups.security_checks: Use separate youth and proxy release checks, with departmental permissions for notes and reports.
groups.acceptance: A transfer between child specialties preserves the active plan and applies the new team's role without extending proxy rights.

groups.name: Sexual health safeguarding and psychology
groups.workflow: Register an appropriately restricted episode, assign a qualified care team and record authorised confidential handovers.
groups.security_checks: Prevent disclosure through routine search, appointment views, messages, proxy pages and exports. Use controlled chain of custody where relevant.
groups.acceptance: An unauthorised user cannot infer a restricted episode from list counts, appointment notifications or an exported summary.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: General and vascular imaging
groups.workflow: Accept a scoped request, assign accession, capture study and report, and route an addendum for acknowledgement.
groups.security_checks: Verify patient/accession linkage, grant short-lived study access, and audit viewer use.
groups.acceptance: A mismatched accession requires reconciliation and cannot publish an image to the chart.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Neuroimaging and molecular imaging
groups.workflow: Route specialist orders to distinct neuro or molecular worklists and publish a signed report with protected study reference.
groups.security_checks: Restrict modality worklists, procedure roles and study access to assigned staff and authorised referring teams.
groups.acceptance: A general imaging operator cannot sign a specialist report without the matching credential and service grant.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Laboratory pathology and transfusion
groups.workflow: Collect and receive specimens, validate identities and reports, route results and record blood component allocation and traceability.
groups.security_checks: Separate collection, result release and unit issue permissions. Review unidentified or mismatched items before publication.
groups.acceptance: Replay a rejection or issue message. Only one recollection task or allocation is created.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Pharmacy and medicine supply
groups.workflow: Prescribe, verify, dispense, reconcile and administer with independent lifecycle transitions.
groups.security_checks: Enforce role and privilege checks per action, protect patient details in stock views and audit approved overrides.
groups.acceptance: A cancelled issue cannot be dispensed. A stock reversal references the original allocation.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Registration patient access and records
groups.workflow: Resolve identity, capture referral or appointment and file appropriately scoped correspondence and discharge records.
groups.security_checks: Separate booking from record filing and from clinical release. Check consent and recipient before connecting records across organisations.
groups.acceptance: Ambiguous identity cannot publish a document. A legitimate booking proceeds after identity resolution.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Hospital operations and quality
groups.workflow: Maintain operational service nodes, cost allocation, asset and capacity availability, incident and quality worklists.
groups.security_checks: Separate clinical, finance, HR and quality roles. Apply de-identification and disclosure controls to reporting.
groups.acceptance: A finance user reconciles an invoice without retrieving clinical notes. A recalled asset becomes unavailable for procedure booking.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Preventive community and home care
groups.workflow: Coordinate outreach, home visits and scheduled prevention services with a named follow-up owner and versioned reporting.
groups.security_checks: Apply jurisdiction and recipient scope to community disclosure and aggregated reporting.
groups.acceptance: An unsuccessful visit retains the outcome and triggers one follow-up. Suppressed report cells cannot be recovered through drill-down.

groups.name: Ear nose and throat and audiology
groups.workflow: ENT accepts referral or emergency consult, books procedures and routes audiology results to the requesting clinician.
groups.security_checks: Restrict audiology results to the treating team and the referring clinician. Apply paediatric proxy checks for newborn screening.
groups.acceptance: Release a newborn hearing screen with a refer outcome. Exactly one follow-up appointment task is created and the parent proxy sees only the released result.

groups.name: Burns plastic and reconstructive surgery
groups.workflow: Burns team records total body surface area and fluid plan on admission, schedules theatre and dressing changes, and hands over to rehabilitation.
groups.security_checks: Clinical photographs are restricted documents visible only to the treating team. Safeguarding flags show for non-accidental injury in children.
groups.acceptance: Amend a burns surface-area assessment. The fluid plan task is reissued once and the earlier assessment remains in history.

groups.name: Mental health and addiction
groups.workflow: Mental health team records assessment, legal status and risk plan, and coordinates admission, community follow-up or crisis review.
groups.security_checks: Records carry the mental_health sensitivity category and need a separate grant. Detention and legal-status changes require a named authorised professional.
groups.acceptance: A clinician without the mental-health grant opens the chart. Mental-health records are withheld and counted, and the denial is audited.

groups.name: Tropical and communicable diseases
groups.workflow: Clinician records a notifiable diagnosis, the isolation decision and contacts. Surveillance reporting is generated and treatment adherence is followed in the community.
groups.security_checks: Isolation status is visible to all staff entering the area. Contact details are limited to the outbreak team. National notification is sent through the reporting interface.
groups.acceptance: Confirm a Lassa fever result. One isolation alert, one notifiable report and one contact-tracing task are created, and a replayed result adds none.

services.name: Lassa fever and viral haemorrhagic fever isolation

groups.name: Child nutrition and growth
groups.workflow: Nutrition team records anthropometry and classification, enrols the child in the appropriate programme and schedules weekly follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Guardian authority is checked for enrolment and discharge. Programme registers are restricted to the nutrition team.
groups.acceptance: Record a weight-for-height below the severe threshold. The child is classified once and one stabilisation referral is created.

services.name: Stabilisation centre for severe acute malnutrition

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Clinical genetics and genomic medicine
groups.workflow: Genetics team accepts referral, records family history and consent, orders genomic tests and releases results with counselling.
groups.security_checks: Results carry the genetics sensitivity category. Disclosure to relatives requires recorded consent.
groups.acceptance: A relative's record is opened by the family's clinician without consent. Genetic results stay withheld and the access is audited.

groups.name: Radiotherapy and radiation oncology
groups.workflow: Clinical oncologist approves the plan. Treatment fractions are scheduled, delivered and recorded, and review findings return to the oncology team.
groups.security_checks: Only credentialed radiographers record delivered fractions. Plan changes need clinical oncologist approval.
groups.acceptance: Record the same fraction twice from a replayed device message. One delivered fraction remains and the course total is correct.

groups.name: Pre-hospital emergency medical services
groups.workflow: Dispatcher creates the incident, the crew records assessment and treatment en route, and the receiving emergency department accepts the handover.
groups.security_checks: Crews see only incidents assigned to their vehicle. Temporary identities are reconciled at handover.
groups.acceptance: Interrupt a handover after transmission. The emergency department receives one arrival and the crew record links once to the confirmed patient.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Mortuary forensic and medico-legal services
groups.workflow: Ward records the death, the doctor certifies it, the mortuary admits the deceased, and release follows identity checks and any legal hold.
groups.security_checks: Legal holds block release and record deletion. Medico-legal reports are released only to authorised requesters.
groups.acceptance: Attempt release of remains under an active legal hold. Release is refused and the attempt is audited.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Occupational and staff health
groups.workflow: Occupational health records the assessment or exposure, schedules follow-up testing and returns a fitness outcome without clinical detail to the manager.
groups.security_checks: A staff member's occupational-health record is hidden from their line manager and colleagues. Managers receive only the fitness outcome.
groups.acceptance: A manager requests a staff member's exposure record. Only the fitness outcome is returned and the request is audited.

groups.division: Diagnostics treatments and shared hospital operations
groups.name: Blood donor services
groups.workflow: Donor services register and screen the donor, record the collection and send units to the blood bank for testing and release.
groups.security_checks: Donor screening answers are restricted to donor services. Reactive results trigger confidential recall only.
groups.acceptance: Mark a unit reactive after release. The unit is quarantined once and the donor recall task is confidential.

groups.name: Orthotics prosthetics and mobility aids
groups.workflow: Rehabilitation refers the patient, the clinician measures and orders the device, then fitting and review are scheduled.
groups.security_checks: Device orders are visible to the rehabilitation team and the supplier only.
groups.acceptance: Cancel a device order after fitting is booked. The appointment is released once and supplier status is updated.

groups.name: Virtual wards and telemedicine
groups.workflow: Clinician admits the patient to a virtual ward, sets monitoring thresholds and reviews alerts. Escalation creates a face-to-face or emergency route.
groups.security_checks: Device data is accepted only from enrolled devices bound to the patient. The patient portal shows readings under the release policy.
groups.acceptance: A device sends a reading for a discharged virtual-ward patient. It is quarantined and no alert is raised.

groups.name: Patient family and visitor support
groups.workflow: Ward or clinic staff refer a patient or family member, or they self-refer. The support team records the request, the outcome and any follow-up.
groups.security_checks: Support staff see contact and need details only, never clinical content. Interpreter bookings carry the language and appointment, not the diagnosis.
groups.acceptance: Book an interpreter for an appointment that is then rescheduled. The booking moves once and the interpreter sees no clinical detail.
